text.p: Video distribution firm Network Entertainment Group Ltd said on Friday it was unlikely to meet forecast prospectus earnings before interest tax and abnormals for the year to June 30, due to weaker than expected sales.
"It appears likely that the earnings before interest, tax and abnormal items forecast as set out in the propectus of October, 1996 will not be met," the company said in a statement.

The company said its sales in the core video sell-through business were 17 percent below budget in December last year. New video rental business was 70 percent below budgeted levels in December, Network Entertainment said.
"As a new entrant into a weak market, Network Entertainment's low cost, direct to video release strategy came under heavy competition from rental sales of major box hits," the company said.
Network Entertainment said it had repositioned its product acquisition and marketing strategy.
Network Entertainment shares closed at A$1.245 on Thursday.
